name: family-finance-education-decision
description: Facts and the user's interpretation about family money and a study-abroad decision, stored among unrelated memories. A vague follow-up must retrieve the connected cluster (facts + the decision + the user's view, labelled as a view) and nothing unrelated.

learn.say: My parents spent about INR 4 lakh on Allen coaching.
My parents bought land worth roughly INR 50 lakh.
I'm considering studying abroad for my master's.
I rejected the University of Leeds offer because the tuition was GBP 25,000.
I may read their refusal to fund as not valuing my education.

remember.text: Plays Valorant with friends every evening and is ranked Diamond
Goes to the gym four times a week and does squats and bench press
Built a gaming PC with an RTX 4070 and 32 GB RAM
Girlfriend is called Olena and they met at college
Likes strong black coffee in the morning
